# data-contract

> Validate tabular datasets against a JSON data contract: schema, types, ranges, uniqueness, SQL-style row rules and a freshness SLA with an injected clock Python package `trysac-data-contract`, import name `data_contract`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
